disclaimer: Decision-support prototype only. Not a diagnosis. Consult a qualified clinician.
limitations: Fine-tuned from the original HAM10000 model with a small web-sourced dark-skin sample (Fitzpatrick17k Fitzpatrick IV-VI, 110 images), 118 Fitzpatrick III images and 215 benign dark-skin lesions from the ISIC Archive. Dark-skin results come from a small locked test set (29 images, 195 benign lesions). Not validated for clinical use on dark skin.
training_data: HAM10000 + Fitzpatrick17k Fitzpatrick IV-VI development set + Fitzpatrick III + ISIC benign dark-skin lesions (development patients)

promotion_rule.result: failed 2 of 5 checks; deployed by the author's decision with the failure documented
failed: false alarms on locked benign dark-skin lesions rose from 0.5% to 4.1% (limit +2 points)
passed: locked dark-skin high-risk catch with flag not lower (0.929 -> 1.000)

previous_model: backend/model/original/ (HAM10000-only model, efficientnet_b3-v0); select it with MODEL_DIR and MODEL_VERSION
